title: Sufficient Sleep: How Much Your Child Needs and Why
summary: At this age, a child needs 10 to 13 hours of sleep daily (including naps). Lack of sleep affects mood, attention, and immunity. Establish a regular bedtime, avoid screens an hour before it, and make pre-sleep time calm: a warm bath and a story. If sleep difficulties persist despite the routine, consult a doctor.
try_this: This week: Set one consistent bedtime every night and create a calm routine half an hour before it, without screens.
reflection_prompts: How many hours does your child actually sleep?
Does he have a fixed sleep routine?
